post.title: Ship Notes Components Demo
post.hook: Three web components, zero dependencies, and one React 19 crash waiting inside.
post.summary: A runnable tour page that vendors three Ship Notes web components unmodified and wires them up, documenting the gotchas found along the way. It also sketches where they could fit in XO.
post.writeup:
## What it is
A demo page for aqualang89/shipnotes-components, a small MIT catalog of single-file custom elements: `<pull-lamp>`, `<signal-orb>` and `<project-stack>`. The three files are vendored unmodified at commit 5930afd, and `index.html` wires them into one tour showing attributes going in and events coming out.

## Why
To evaluate the components for XO. The README sketches two fits: the orb as agent status in the xo-coworker chat (composing, streaming, tool call, done mapped to its four states), and the lamp as a theme switch on xo-main or xo-room.

## How it works
Each component is one JS file, Shadow DOM, no build. The page sets attributes and listens for events. `demo.js` holds the host wiring, and `scripts/sync-upstream.sh` re-vendors from a branch, tag or commit and rewrites `UPSTREAM.md`.

The page has live panels: the lamp drives the page theme, the orb has state, level and particle controls plus a simulated agent turn, and the stack lets you edit JSON and try hostile input.

## Findings
Wiring it up surfaced real gotchas:
- React 19 throws on `<signal-orb state="thinking" />` because the orb exposes getters with no setters. Setting attributes via a ref works.
- React event props are case-sensitive: `onthemechange` works, `onThemeChange` never fires.
- Project Stack reads its JSON once, and needs exactly three items or it silently shows its sample.
- The orb's automatic particle budget only goes down: 40% after 30 slow frames, floor 800.
- Upstream only tested Chromium.

## Open questions
Upstream setters would remove the React workaround. Only the lamp emits events, so the stack's selected card has no change signal. The repo has a single commit so far, dated 2026-09-26.
